QUOTE: `mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init()` installs its own calloc/free at lines 570-575 (a mutex-wrapped pair when `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is on). That call replaces any allocator you set earlier, so order matters.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer mentions a mutex-wrapped pair under MBEDTLS_THREADING_C but never says a plain pair is installed otherwise, nor that the choice is made at compile time inside init.
